resources.string: Includes chats, saved drafts, the unsent new-chat draft, picked files and generated images. Settings, account credentials, environments, request parameters and provider diagnostics are excluded. The ZIP contains readable chat contents. Each file can be up to 32 MiB, with up to 256 MiB of media in total.
